Rewrite trainable-corpus instructions into a registered target voice
(STYLE_MODES: goal | qa_verify), resumable via metadata.instruction_style.

positional arguments:
  corpus

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --mode {goal,qa_verify}
  --apply
  --dry-run             List the selection and exit (default); qa_verify also
                        previews old -> new without writing
  --workers WORKERS
  --limit LIMIT
